groupings.title: Send email from your app
groupings.description: Password resets, sign-in links, receipts, invitations and notifications over REST or SMTP, with the official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, Laravel, Symfony and Nodemailer transports, Next.js, Express, React Email, Django and Rails recipes, and plain HTTPS for every other language.

groupings.title: Operate, migrate and scale
groupings.description: Domain authentication, signed delivery webhooks and suppressions, migration from another provider, and optional sub-accounts when your users or agents send through your app.
